messages:
marco: Quick sync — we need a telemetry contract from runtime so Product/Console can build per-route SLO dashboards (P50/P95/P99, TTFT, tokens/sec). Anyone free now?

lina: I can do the runtime side. What exact labels/metrics do you need? route/model/version? seq_len?

anya: For Console UX we want: P50/P95/P99 request latency, TTFT (time-to-first-token) per route+model, tokens/sec (ingest rate), requests/sec, error rate. Also per-model SLO tags for rollout linking :eyes:

sam: Agree. We should avoid high-cardinality labels. Suggest required labels: model_id (hashed ok), route, model_variant (coarse), region, server_pool. Optional: batch_size, seq_len_bucket. Avoid user_id or request_id in metrics labels.

marco: That sounds good. Can we get latency as histogram + TTFT histogram? We rely on histogram_quantile in Grafana.

lina: Plan: emit these metrics from runtime:
```
redwood_request_latency_seconds_bucket{model="<id>",route="<name>",region="<r>"}
redwood_request_latency_seconds_sum / _count
redwood_ttft_seconds_bucket{...}
redwood_tokens_emitted_total{...}
redwood_requests_total{...}
redwood_request_errors_total{...}
```
I'll add optional labels: batch_size_bucket, seq_len_bucket (low/med/high) to keep cardinality small.

sam: For ingestion: apply a tagging pipeline that maps full model_version -> model_id (sha1) so dashboards don't show huge variant list. Also add metric relabeling to drop empty labels. We'll sample traces at 1% by default for trace payloads.

anya: Grafana layout idea (per-route row): 1) P50/P95/P99 latency panel (PromQL using histogram_quantile), 2) TTFT panel, 3) tokens/sec + requests/sec heatmap, 4) error rate + recent rollouts. Need stable metric names to link rollouts UI to the correct series.

marco: Example PromQLs — please review:
```
# P95 request latency per route
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model_id, route))

# TTFT P95
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_ttft_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model_id, route))

# tokens/sec per route
sum(rate(redwood_tokens_emitted_total[1m])) by (model_id, route)

# error rate
sum(rate(redwood_request_errors_total[5m])) by (model_id, route) / sum(rate(redwood_requests_total[5m])) by (model_id, route)
```

lina: Those are fine. One note: histogram_quantile can be noisy for small counts — we'll add `or on() vector(0)` + min_sample_count alert in infra.

sam: Telemetry ops: we'll add ingestion docs and a small Prometheus relabel config. Also need a contract doc with examples and a testing harness (k6 script + synthetic traces) to validate metrics.

anya: UX asks: expose a stable numeric model_id in the metrics and a mapping endpoint `/models/manifest` for Console to resolve id->display name (only for UI, not in metrics). Also want `slo_group` label to let teams group multiple routes under one SLO.

marco: Sounds like an action list. I'll create a PR for dashboard panel defs. @lina @sam can you add the metric emits + relabel config? I'll draft the rollout linking changes in Console. Deadline EOD Thursday?

lina: Yup. I'll add feature flag and small perf test.

sam: I'll add ingestion config and a test harness. cc @deploy-bot to trigger a canary once metrics land.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: New telemetry branch pushed to staging. Run `./scripts/telemetry-smoke.sh` and report failures.

marco: Thanks team — syncing again tomorrow AM if needed. :thumbsup:
